messages:
Alex: Quick check — final RN draft is in the doc (link). Landing today 16:00 UTC. Need ops signoff on rollback windows and confirm deploybot cue.
Jamie: Skimmed — looks good. microcopy on the safety section needs tightening (users -> customers).
Sara: I can do a quick pass in 10m. Also confirm: are we pinning model v2.3.1 for the initial rollout?
Alex: Yes pin to v2.3.1 for 24h canary. If traffic looks good, we auto-roll to v2.3.2 after 24h.
Will: Deploybot shows a scheduled run at 16:00 UTC for this thread id. @deploybot show canary config
deploybot: Scheduled: 2024-09-15T16:00:00Z. Canary: 5% traffic, 24h. Fallback: immediate pin rollback to v2.3.0 on failure.
Jamie: Question on "immediate" — define failure thresholds we can ship in RN. I propose: >=5% error rate over a 5m window OR latency p95 > 2s for 3 consecutive 5m buckets triggers rollback.
Sara: +1. Add a note that staged fallback will notify on-call and open incident channel. Also add a hotfix owner for rollback: @Will.
Will: I can be on-call for the initial 4h post-launch. If I trigger rollback, command is:
```
redwood rollback --service inference --to v2.3.0 --reason "canary failure"
```
Alex: Nice. Add that exactly to the RN ops section. Also include a short blurb for PMs: "No expected user-visible changes; minor perf gains for long responses."
Jamie: Microcopy tweak suggestion: change "minor perf gains" -> "performance improvements for long-form outputs (expected ~5-10% faster)"
Sara: I'll update doc and paste final snippet here in 15m. Do we want a staged announcement cadence? internal first, then customer-facing 2h later?
Alex: Yes internal 10m before deploy, customer blast ~2h after successful canary. Add embargo note.
Will: Also confirm rollback playbook link included — devex runbook needs the exact run steps. If not present, I'll paste minimal steps after deploy.
Sara: Pasting updated RN snippet: "Ops: canary to v2.3.1 at 16:00 UTC (5% traffic, 24h). Rollback triggers: >=5% 5xxs over 5m OR p95 latency >2s for 3 buckets. Rollback command shown; on-call: Will. Internal announce at T-10m, customer notify T+2h post-canary success"
Jamie: LGTM. Anyone object to me posting the internal announcement 10m before?
Alex: No objections. Go ahead. I'll keep watch on deploybot channel and oncall. :eyes:
deploybot: Reminder scheduled in 10m for thread 1766001234.
Will: I'll be around. If I need to escalate, I'll call the oncall lead and open incident.
Sara: Thanks team — updating RN and sending internal announce in 8m.
Alex: Thanks — tagging this as pinned for the release notes folder. :thumbsup:
